albums.blurb: Kiasmos is the duo of Icelandic composer Ólafur Arnalds and Faroese producer Janus Rasmussen, an outlet for the club-facing side of Arnalds's otherwise neoclassical catalog. Their self-titled debut, recorded at Arnalds's Reykjavík studio and released on Erased Tapes in October 2014, sets grand piano, string quartet, and live drums against drum machines and slow-building 4/4 pulses across eight one-word-titled tracks, and it remained the duo's only full-length until II followed in 2024.
albums.reception: The album holds a score of 86/100 on the review aggregator Metacritic, indicating universal acclaim.

albums.album: Modern Johnny Sings: Songs in the Age of Vibe
albums.blurb: Katzman is a founding member of Vulfpeck, though his solo records swap the band's instrumental funk for 1970s-styled rock-and-soul songcraft. Modern Johnny Sings: Songs in the Age of Vibe, his third studio album, was self-released in January 2020 on his Ten Good Songs label and delivers its twelve songs in the voice of a "Modern Johnny" alter ego introduced on two preceding EPs; a live rendition, Songs in the Age of Live, followed in 2022.
albums.reception: In a contemporary review, Washington State University station KZUU called the album "an incredibly strong start to a new decade of music."

albums.blurb: Dijon Duenas is a Baltimore-area singer and producer who started out as half of the lo-fi R&B duo Abhi//Dijon before going solo in 2017. Absolutely, released in November 2021 on R&R and Warner Records, is his debut studio album after a run of singles and EPs; it was announced with a live-in-the-room performance film and made with a tight circle of collaborators including guitarist Mk.gee, and its follow-up, Baby, arrived in 2025.
albums.reception: Pitchfork scored the album 7.2, with critic Stephen Kearse writing that the "roaming, Americana-obsessed songwriter brings a sense of purpose to his zigzagging" on this debut.
